entries.headline: CJ Abrams stayed in the yard

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber came close
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 1-for-4 against José Soriano and the Toronto Blue Jays. Closest call was a double in the 3rd: "Kyle Schwarber doubles (13) on a ground ball to left fielder Jesús Sánchez." The power showed up; the carry did not.
